key.description: Key is used to retrieve the corresponding parameter value. This should be unique for a given fired event. These parameters must be predefined in the integration definition.

value.description: Values for the defined keys. Each value can either be string, int, double or any proto message.

snapshotNumber.description: Optional. An increasing sequence that is set when a new snapshot is created. The last created snapshot can be identified by [workflow_name, org_id latest(snapshot_number)]. However, last created snapshot need not be same as the HEAD. So users should always use "HEAD" tag to identify the head.

taskConfigs.description: Optional. Task configuration for the integration. It's optional, but the integration doesn't do anything without task_configs.

userLabel.description: Optional. A user-defined label that annotates an integration version. Typically, this is only set when the integration version is created.

integrationConfigParameters.description: Optional. Config Parameters that are expected to be passed to the integration when an integration is published. This consists of all the parameters that are expected to provide configuration in the integration execution. This gives the user the ability to provide default values, value, add information like connection url, project based configuration value and also provide data types of each parameter.

errorCatcherConfigs.description: Optional. Error Catch Task configuration for the integration. It's optional.

integrationParameters.description: Optional. Parameters that are expected to be passed to the integration when an event is triggered. This consists of all the parameters that are expected in the integration execution. This gives the user the ability to provide default values, add information like PII and also provide data types of each parameter.

state.description: Output only. User should not set it as an input.

GoogleCloudIntegrationsV2TaskExecution.description: Execution of a single task within an integration

variables.description: Optional. Variables used during the execution.

taskExecutionMetadata.description: Optional. Metadata of the task execution.

GoogleCloudIntegrationsV2DuetTriggerConf.description: Variables names mapped to api trigger.

GoogleCloudIntegrationsV2Execution.description: The Execution contains detailed information of an individual integration execution.

triggerId.description: The ID of the trigger invoked at the start of the execution.

executionAttemptStats.description: Start and end time of each execution attempt.

updateTime.description: Output only. Time the execution is recently updated.

cloudLoggingDetails.description: Cloud Logging details for the integration version

requestVariables.description: Optional. Variables provided in the request.

createTime.description: Output only. Time the execution is created.

containTaskVariables.description: Indicates if the task execution contains variables.

enumDescriptions: Execution is scheduled and awaiting to be triggered.
Execution successfully finished. There are no more changes after this state.
Execution failed. There's no more change after this state.
Execution is cancelled. There's no more change after this state.
Execution failed and is waiting for retry.
Execution suspended and waiting for manual intervention.
state.description: Output only. Status of the execution.

integrationVersionNumber.description: Indicates which snapshot of integration is used for this execution.

replayInfo.description: Output only. Replay info for the execution

responseVariables.description: Optional. Variables returned as part of the response.

integrationVersionUserLabel.description: Optional. User-defined label that annotates the executed integration version.

GoogleCloudIntegrationsV2DuetIntParamete.description: This message only contains a field of integer array.

GoogleCloudIntegrationsV2CloudLoggingDet.description: Cloud Logging details for execution info

cloudLoggingSeverity.description: Optional. Severity selected by the customer for the logs to be sent to Cloud Logging, for the integration version getting executed.
enumDescriptions: If Severity selected is `INFO`, then all the Integration Execution States (`IN_PROCESS`, `ON_HOLD`, `SUCCEEDED`, `SUSPENDED`, `ERROR`, `CANCELLED`) will be sent to Cloud Logging.
If Severity selected is `ERROR`, then only the following Integration Execution States (`ERROR`, `CANCELLED`) will be sent to Cloud Logging.
If Severity selected is `WARNING`, then only the following Integration Execution States (`ERROR`, `CANCELLED`) will be sent to Cloud Logging.

enableCloudLogging.description: Optional. Status of whether Cloud Logging is enabled or not for the integration version getting executed.

integrationDocumentRequest.description: Required. The integration document request payload.

GoogleCloudIntegrationsV2DuetGenerateInt.description: Request message for generating documentation for an integration version.
